meta.name: audience-analyzer
meta.description: Use when the user asks to "analyze my target audience" or "build an audience profile for influencer targeting"; produces demographic/psychographic profiles, platform-priority matrices, named personas, and influencer-selection criteria. Not for finding specific creators — use influencer-discovery; not for niche community deep-dives — use niche-researcher.

copy.tagline_en: Analyze target audience and generate profiles with platform strategies.
